name: Taiwan
famous_for: Taipei 101 skyscraper, vibrant night markets (Shilin), birthplace of Bubble Tea, Taroko Gorge marble canyon, and high-tech semiconductor chips.
tourists: Over 11.8M international visitors; famous for Jiufen mountain lantern village, Sun Moon Lake, and National Palace Museum imperial treasures.
must_know: Taiwan's night market culture is world-famous: eating 'small bites' (xiaochi) while strolling through bustling evening lanes is a daily ritual.
fun_fact: Taipei 101 was the world's tallest building from 2004 to 2010 and contains a massive 660-tonne tuned mass damper pendulum inside its top floors.
